note: Effect targets of sheet numbers added in packages 16 and 17. Older targets (ac, attack, damage, save, save:<id>, skill, skill:<id>, initiative, cmb, cmd, speed, crit_range, lucky, touch_armor, armor_slowdown_reduction, spell_penalty_mana, spell_failure_pct, twf_reduction, block_*) are in RULES/buffs.md. A target with ':' takes an id after it.

targets.stat:: ability score (stat:str ... stat:cha): typed bonuses stack by the normal rules; the modifier and everything built on it follow
targets.extra_hit_dice: one extra hit die per effect; the value is the HP of that die; it counts max(1, value + current Con mod) like every die
targets.balance_max: balance max (also inside the start-of-combat snapshot)
targets.slots:: max spell slots of one circle (slots:1 ... slots:9, slots:0 = cantrips)
targets.pool_max:: max of one resource pool (pool_max:<pool id>)
targets.comfort_rate_bonus: training per comfort point in exchange_comfort
targets.attack_melee: the general melee attack number of the sheet (package 34: its manual source rows)
targets.attack_ranged: the general ranged attack number of the sheet (package 34: its manual source rows)
targets.parry_cells: AC cells where parry works: effect cells added (value >= 0) or removed (value < 0) (package 24 B2)
targets.shield_cells: AC cells a held shield covers: cells added (value >= 0) or removed (value < 0) (package 24 B2)
targets.dex_loss_cells: AC cells losing Dex and dodge: cells added (value >= 0) or removed (value < 0) (package 24 B2)
targets.dex_loss_chance_pct: percent chance that the Dex loss is cancelled in a Dex-loss cell (package 24 B2)
targets.max_dex: Dex cap of the worn armor (only when a cap exists)
targets.armor_skill_penalty: added to the armor skill penalty (positive = smaller penalty, never above 0)
targets.load_mod: added to the Str modifier used for the load thresholds
targets.actions_max: actions per turn (package 26 A): added to the base 3
targets.attention_per_cycle: attention at the end of a cycle
targets.crit_mult: crit multiplier (weapon id = that weapon only)
targets.iterative_penalty: makes every step of the iterative penalty smaller (a step never goes above 0)
targets.dr: damage reduction vs physical damage; Effect.note = the bypass text (narrative only); Effect.stacks: total = the largest non-stacking entry + all stacking entries
targets.resist:: flat resistance to one damage type (resist:fire ...); never stacks, the larger wins
targets.spell_resistance: spell resistance (shown only, not a damage step)
targets.spell_price_discount: training subtracted from a new spell's price after the spellbook half; minimum 1
targets.pain_cap: pain count at which the character dies (default 8)
targets.pain_penalty_per_pain: roll penalty per pain point (default 1; -1 makes 0, never below 0)
targets.damage_per_pain: damage bonus per pain point (race rule)
targets.item_hp: max HP of items (Effect.weapon = one item id; none = every item); not from item tabs
targets.item_hardness: hardness of items (Effect.weapon = one item id; none = every item); never below 0
targets.morale_scale: count the morale scale X higher (defense.md; the scale stays -10..10)
targets.short_rest_heal: added to the free heal of the short rest (after the 'larger of' rule)
targets.short_rest_bp: extra BP gained by the short rest
targets.spell_cost: mana cost of every circle 1+ spell (never below 0)
targets.spell_overload: overload gained by every cast (never below 0)
targets.mana_level: the most one spell may cost in mana (level + this)
targets.percent:: signed percent damage modifier of one type (percent:fire 50 = 50% more, -100 = immune)
targets.temp_hp: own temp HP of the character (manual source rows, own feats / items; package 35, owner Q229): added on read, spent by damage after the 'by button' pool and before buff temp HP (counted in temp_hp_spent), cleared by the short rest; temp HP from an external effect is a status (temp_hp_left)
